section4_crux.finding: SLICE mode sets create_response:TRUE (realtimeVoice buildRealtimeSessionUpdate) → the SERVER auto-responds to user audio WITHOUT a client response.create. The current client-side response lease is therefore NOT AUTHORITATIVE: an auto-response can overlap a client post-tool/repair response.create.
section4_crux.chosen_design: Option B (server-automatic with OBSERVED lease): the ResponseLifecycle observes the provider response via response_created (auto OR client) → ACTIVE; a client createResponse while ACTIVE is blocked; post-tool/repair are sequential after the prior response is terminal.
section4_crux.boolean_lease_status: SUPERSEDED-PENDING-WIRING. The committed boolean lease (responseLease) has the holes you named (released on transcript-done, reset on new input, text dedup). It is replaced by src/services/responseLifecycle.ts.

responseLifecycle.terminal_rule: a new response starts only when previous ResponseState terminal AND AudioState quiet; transcript-done is NOT terminal; turn identity = provider item id + generation (never text); new input during output = INTERRUPTION (cancel+drain), not reset; terminal for wrong response id rejected.
